therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Subjects with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (mCRPC)
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Number of participants with dose-limiting toxicities and determination of maximum tolerated dose

results.dose_information: PLX2853 20 mg, 40 mg, and 80 mg in combination with either olaparib or abiraterone acetate plus prednisone

context.investigator_commentary: Study terminated and MTD not determined as DLTs not observed in 2 subjects or more per protocol definition
